Comisión Europea, Agri-food Data Portal:.en: European Commission, Agri-food Data Portal: aggregated monthly price of phosphate (P) fertilisers in several EU markets, EUR/tonne, based on market intelligence services. It is NOT DAP: the Commission does not specify the product, so it is not comparable with DAP or with the DTN index. The API does not publish a release date: the day the figure was first retrieved is recorded.
